title: Q-FLEETMAP-seed: ultrastable/seed is not equal to its source (9 file(s) differ, 2 missing, 0 only in the copy)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** fleetmap --drift --apply (daily in tenant-sync.yml)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe seed
**Prediction:** fleet_map_drifted_repos <= 0 within 168 h
**Status:** open

ultrastable/seed is a copy and is not equal to its source (FLEET-MAP-1): 9 file(s) differ, 2 missing, 0 only in the copy.

- differ: README.md, SYSTEM.md, autonomy/retention.json, docs/claims.json, worker/src/index.js, worker/src/migrate.js, worker/src/tick.js, worker/test/migrate.test.js, worker/test/tick.test.js
- missing: worker/src/switches.js, worker/test/switches.test.js

Fix the sync named in doctrine/fleet-map.json for this repository (never copy by hand), then the same reading closes this item.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe seed
